proposals.before: The learner can explain inductive and mesomeric effects in secondary substitutions and discuss examples such as toluene or phenol.
proposals.after: The learner can explain inductive and resonance effects in secondary substitutions and discuss the directing effects using examples such as toluene, phenol, aniline and nitrobenzene.
proposals.reason: Current English omits aniline/nitrobenzene and weakens the explicitly stated directing effect present in German and HE Q2.3.

proposals.before: Die lernende Person kann induktive und mesomere Effekte anwenden, um Acidität und Basizität ausgewählter Teilchen vergleichend zu begründen.
proposals.after: Die lernende Person kann zu ausgewählten einfachen organischen Verbindungen recherchieren und deren Acidität und Basizität mit induktiven und mesomeren Effekten vergleichend begründen.
proposals.afterEn: The learner can research selected simple organic compounds and comparatively justify their acidity and basicity using inductive and resonance effects.
proposals.reason: BY bf96116a has actual recherchieren plus erklären. A body change requires explicitly assessed source access in the profile; current cases do not pretend it occurred.
